headline: Weekend headline risk stays elevated while live NQ structure is unavailable
body: NQ futures are closed, so current one-way structure, shallow pullbacks and failed retracements cannot be observed. Fresh reporting indicates improved Strait of Hormuz energy flows, while Riyadh-area security alerts and damage to Saudi Arabia's East-West pipeline keep energy and geopolitical uncertainty elevated. Friday's Nasdaq gain was semiconductor-led despite negative breadth, with Treasury yields above 5% and crude above $100.
